concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑002 (spec) mandates **median imputation** for missing protein values, but the plan (section 3) specifies **Left‑Censored Missing (LCM) imputation**. This deviation is not justified and may alter the distribution of predictor variables, affecting the scientific validity of the regression results.

The plan computes the aggregated gene‑expression target (first principal component) on the **full transcriptomic matrix before any train‑test split**. While the target is independent of proteomic predictors, deriving the PC loadings on the entire dataset can introduce subtle leakage of test‑set information into the target definition, which is discouraged in rigorous cross‑validation practice.
